name: Empirical Aesthetics of Bridges: Four-Scale Ratings
description: Faithful replication: same task, scales and photographs as the paper (Experiment 2). Participants see a random half (59) of the 117 bridge photographs from the authors' Bridge Design and Aesthetics (BDA) dataset. For each bridge, with the photo staying on screen, they rate four statements on a 5-point scale from strongly disagree to strongly agree: "I find the design of the bridge to be aesthetically appealing", "...complex", "...interesting" and "I would feel safe crossing this bridge", then answer "Do you recognize this bridge?". Age, gender and four yes/no background questions (architecture and engineering background and education) come first; two attention checks are built in. The paper z-scores ratings per participant, averages them per image, drops recognised bridges and relates the ratings to bridge type, material, age and depth with Factorial Analysis of Mixed Data. The page source holds every bridge's name, design features and the paper's mean z-scores. Photographs: Yang, Damiano, Gauvreau & Walther, OSF wf5qg, used as published there; they will be removed if the authors object. Differences from the original study: (1) runs as one web page instead of jsPsych; (2) attention checks ask for a specific answer on screen instead of a key press; (3) a short break every 20 bridges; (4) photos resized to at most 1400 px. Cite: Yang, Damiano, Gauvreau & Walther (2025), PLOS ONE 20(12): e0338493.
author: Yang et al.

:root{--bg:#e9e9e9;--card:#fff;--ink:#1d1d1f;--muted:#5d5d63;--accent:#2f5d8a;--line:#d4d4d8;--warn:#b3261e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.45rem;margin:0 0 8px}p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 18px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.progress{height:6px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0 12px}.progress>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
.view{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;aspect-ratio:5/4;max-height:56vh;margin:0 auto}
.view img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block;border-radius:6px}
.q{font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 8px;text-align:center;min-height:1.5em}
.scale{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px}
.scale button{appearance:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 4px;font:inherit;font-size:.88rem;cursor:pointer;min-width:0;line-height:1.25}
.scale button b{display:block;font-size:1.05rem}
.scale.two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);max-width:360px;margin:0 auto}
.scale button:hover,.scale button:focus-visible{border-color:var(--accent);outline:none}
.step{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
table.m{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:8px}table.m td{padding:7px 4px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}table.m td.c{text-align:center;width:56px}
input[type=number]{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:110px}
.f{margin-top:14px}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}

      '<div class="card"><label class="opt" style="margin-top:0"><input type="checkbox" id="ok"> '+esc(Q.consent.title)+'</label><div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="go">Start</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      if(!document.getElementById('ok').checked)return err('Consent is needed to continue.');
      var av=Number(document.getElementById('age').value);if(!(av>=18&&av<=99))return err('Please enter your age (18–99).');
      var g=app.querySelector('input[name=gender]:checked');if(!g)return err('Please answer the gender question.');
      var m={},miss=false;(bg.rows||[]).forEach(function(r){var x=app.querySelector('input[name="bg_'+r.value+'"]:checked');if(!x)miss=true;else m[r.value]=x.value;});
      if(miss)return err('Please answer all four background questions.');
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;
      Promise.all([SPSite.answer('consent',true),SPSite.answer('age',av),SPSite.answer('gender',g.value),SPSite.answer('background',m)]).then(function(rs){var bad=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(bad){b.disabled=false;return err(bad.error);}st.step='task';save();route();});
    };
  }
  function scaleHtml(two){
    if(two)return '<div class="scale two">'+(Q.recognized.choices||[]).map(function(c){return '<button data-v="'+esc(c.value)+'"><b>'+esc(c.text)+'</b></button>';}).join('')+'</div>';
    var s='';for(var v=1;v<=5;v++)s+='<button data-v="'+v+'"><b>'+v+'</b>'+LABELS[v-1]+'</button>';return '<div class="scale">'+s+'</div>';
  }
  function task(){
    if(st.i>=st.list.length){st.step='end';save();return route();}
    if(st.i>0&&st.i%BREAK_EVERY===0&&st.item===0&&!st['br'+st.i]){
      app.innerHTML='<h1>Short break</h1><div class="card"><p>You have rated '+st.i+' of '+st.list.length+' bridges. Take a short rest if you like.</p><button class="btn" id="go">Continue</button></div>';
      document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){st['br'+st.i]=true;save();task();};return;
    }
    var f=byName(st.list[st.i]);if(!f){st.i++;st.item=0;save();return task();}
    var nf=byName(st.list[st.i+1]||'');if(nf){var pre=new Image();pre.src=nf.url;}
    var ci=st.checks.indexOf(st.i), isCheck=ci>=0&&st.item===4&&st.attDone.indexOf(ci)<0, target=ci===0?2:4;
    var name=st.item<4?ITEMS[st.item]:'recognized', q=Q[name]||{};
    var title=isCheck?'Attention check: please click '+target+' ('+LABELS[target-1]+').':q.title;
    app.innerHTML='<p>Bridge '+(st.i+1)+' of '+st.list.length+'</p><div class="progress"><i style="width:'+(100*(st.i*5+st.item)/(st.list.length*5))+'%"></i></div>'+
      '<div class="view"><img alt="Photograph of a bridge" src="'+esc(f.url)+'"></div>'+
      '<div class="card"><div class="step">'+(isCheck?'':'Statement '+(st.item+1)+' of 5')+'</div><div class="q">'+esc(title)+'</div>'+scaleHtml(!isCheck&&st.item===4)+'<div class="err"></div></div>';
    var btns=app.querySelectorAll('.scale button');
    btns.forEach(function(x){x.onclick=function(){
      btns.forEach(function(y){y.disabled=true;});
      var v=x.getAttribute('data-v');
      if(isCheck){if(Number(v)===target)st.att++;st.attDone.push(ci);save();return task();}
      var val=st.item<4?Number(v):v;
      SPSite.answer(name,val,{key:key(f),shown:[f.name]}).then(function(r){
        if(!ok(r)){btns.forEach(function(y){y.disabled=false;});return err(r.error);}
        st.item++;if(st.item>4){st.item=0;st.i++;}save();task();
      });
    };});
  }
  function end(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Almost done</h1><div class="card"><b>'+esc(Q.tech_problems.title)+'</b>'+(Q.tech_problems.choices||[]).map(function(c){return '<label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="tp" value="'+esc(c.value)+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('')+'<div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="go">Finish</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      var t=app.querySelector('input[name=tp]:checked');if(!t)return err('Please answer the question.');
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;
      Promise.all([SPSite.answer('tech_problems',t.value),SPSite.answer('attention_passed',st.att)]).then(function(rs){var bad=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(bad){b.disabled=false;return err(bad.error);}finish();});
    };
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');setTimeout(function(){var m=r.missing||[];if(m.some(function(x){return ['consent','age','gender','background'].indexOf(x)>=0;}))st.step='intro';else if(m.some(function(x){return ITEMS.indexOf(x)>=0||x==='recognized';})){st.step='task';st.i=0;st.item=0;}else st.step='end';save();route();},1800);}
      else{try{localStorage.removeItem('bda2025:state');}catch(e){}var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your ratings are saved.';}});
  }
  function route(){if(st.step==='task')return task();if(st.step==='end')return end();intro();}
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    ['consent','age','gender','background','aesthetic','complexity','interest','safety','recognized','attention_passed','tech_problems'].forEach(function(n){Q[n]=SPSite.getQuestion(n)||{};});
    files=(SPSite.getMedia('bridges')||[]).filter(function(f){return /\.(jpe?g|png|webp)$/i.test(f.name);});
    if(files.length<2){app.innerHTML='<h1>Photographs missing</h1><p>Upload the bridge photographs to the media folder “bridges”.</p>';return;}
    try{st=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bda2025:state'));}catch(e){st=null;}
    if(!st||!Array.isArray(st.list)||st.list.some(function(n){return !byName(n);}))st=newState();
    var a=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};
    if(a.consent!==true)st.step='intro';
    save();route();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Rate photographs of bridges from around the world. Each participant sees a random half (59) of the 117 bridge photographs from the Bridge Design and Aesthetics (BDA) dataset and, for each, rates four statements on a 5-point scale (aesthetically appealing, complex, interesting, safe to cross) and says whether they recognise the bridge. Rebuilt from Yang, Damiano, Gauvreau & Walther (2025), PLOS ONE 20(12): e0338493, Experiment 2, with the authors' photographs from OSF wf5qg (used as published there; they will be removed if the authors object).
